description: Defines the QuicInterval template class used for representing and manipulating contiguous ranges over ordered types, including operations like containment, intersection, union, and difference.

classes.name: QuicInterval
classes.description: A template class representing a half-open interval [min, max) over an ordered type T, supporting range operations.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a value or another interval is contained within the interval.

methods.name: Intersects
methods.description: Checks if this interval intersects with another interval.

methods.name: IntersectWith
methods.description: Modifies this interval to be its intersection with another interval.

methods.name: SpanningUnion
methods.description: Expands this interval to include another interval, forming their union.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between this interval and another, returning resulting sub-intervals.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the interval.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the interval is empty (min >= max).
